columns.name: is_cured_in_month

columns.comment: True when EAD / RWA / ECL are available for the month (from Apr-2024).
columns.name: has_capital_measures

comment: Month-end credit exposure and delinquency per facility (brief 5.4 delinquency, PLAN 7), Apr-2023 to Sep-2026: limit, drawn, undrawn and utilisation; EAD, RWA, risk weight, PD / LGD and IFRS 9 ECL (12-month, lifetime and the stage-based provision ecl_usd, from Apr-2024; obligor values allocated to facilities pro rata to facility EAD so client and group totals are exact); IFRS 9 stage and internal grade; days past due and DPD bucket at the month-end (Current, 1-29, 30-59, 60-89, 90+), overdue amount, 30+ / 90+ DPD flags and the cure flags. Point-in-time snapshot: sum balances across facilities / clients for one month-end, never across months. 30+ DPD rate = SUM(drawn_usd where is_30_plus_dpd) / SUM(drawn_usd) (or facility counts); cure rate = facilities with is_cured_in_month / facilities with in_arrears_during_month. Grain: one row per facility x month-end.
